summary: Implemented the CharDistributionAnalysis base reset, feed, get_confidence and got_enough_data, plus get_order for all nine subclasses (EUC-TW, EUC-KR, JOHAB, GB2312, Big5, SJIS, EUC-JP), and the HebrewProber reset, model wiring, final-letter feed, state property, charset decision and confidence. The last full-suite run gave 34 passed and 342 failed; the remaining failures come from mbcharsetprober.py (NotImplementedError), codingstatemachine.py (missing reset and language) and other builders' files.
